To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of a dual-energy X-ray absorp-tiometry (DXA) scanner with a dedicated protocol for the assessment of visceral adipose tissue (VAT) in patients with Prader–Willi syndrome (PWS), is a valid method for the measurement of VAT; 2) VAT increases with age in patients with PWS, and 3) growth hormone (GH) therapy reduces VAT in PWS patients.
the dual-energy X-ray absorptive (DEXA) method is a valid and accurate method to estimate visceral abdominal fat in patients with Prader-Wlli syndrome (PWS) during growth hormone therapy.

the use of GH in adults with Prader- Willi syndrome is safe and effective.
